description_en: Sets multiple key-value pairs in a specified namespace
description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量设置指定KV存储空间的键值对
kebab_example: aliyun esa batch-put-kv --namespace test_namespace --kv-list ExpirationTtl=3600 Value=test_value Expiration=1690081381 Key=test_key --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchPutKv

parameters.help_en: The name specified when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html
parameters.name: namespace

element_fields.help_en: The name of the key. The key can be up to 512 characters long and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/)
element_fields.help_zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The expiration time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and cannot be earlier than the current time. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
element_fields.help_zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
element_fields.name: expiration

element_fields.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL). This is a relative time in seconds. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
element_fields.help_zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
element_fields.name: expiration_ttl

parameters.help_en: The list of key-value pairs to set. The total size cannot exceed 2 MB (2 × 1,000 × 1,000)
parameters.help_zh: 需要批量设置的键值对列表，总大小最大2MB(2\*1000\*1000)
parameters.name: kv_list
